followUps.lookupsFailed: Some option lists could not be loaded. Close the dialog and try again.

complete.noStatuses: No statuses for this contract and reachability
complete.nextNote: The note carries this callback time, so the legacy next-calls report shows it too.
complete.lateNote: This follow-up is late. Completing it keeps its due time and records that it was completed late.

reschedule.nextActionHint: Optional. Leave as it is to keep the current next action.

corr.title: Case corrections
corr.subtitle: Reviewed changes to identity, name, additional fields, original debt and delinquency. Nothing changes until another reviewer approves.
corr.emptyHint: No correction in your scope matches this status and these filters.
corr.countsUnavailable: The tab counts could not be loaded.
corr.staleTitle: The case changed since this request
corr.staleLive: The highlighted fields no longer hold the 'before' value. Approving will be refused; reject this request or ask for a new one.
corr.staleExplain: Nothing was changed and the correction is still pending. The values below were expected but the case now holds different ones.
corr.caseLocked: The case is locked. It must be unlocked before this correction can be approved.
corr.belowApprovedTitle: The new debt is below the approved payments
corr.belowApprovedHint: approval will be refused while this is so.

warning.contacts_follow_identity: Contacts stay with the old identity number

corr.contactsFollowIdentity: Contacts are linked by identity number and do not move. Now linked to the old number: {{before}}; already linked to the new number: {{after}}.
corr.ownRequestNote: You requested this correction, so another reviewer must approve or reject it.
corr.approveHint: The case is changed at once to the 'after' values, and the before/after values are kept in the history with your name.
corr.approvedToast: The correction was approved and applied.
corr.rejectHint: The case is not changed. Tell the requester why.
corr.cancelHint: The request is withdrawn and the case is not changed.
corr.caseSubtitle: Pending and past corrections of this case, newest first.
corr.caseEmptyTitle: No correction was requested for this case
corr.caseEmptyHint: Use 'Request correction' to propose a reviewed change.
corr.requestHint: Nothing changes until another user with the review permission approves the request. The current values are recorded as 'before'.
corr.requestedToast: The correction was sent for review.

balance.title: Case balance
balance.overpaidHint: Approved payments exceed the original debt. Outstanding:
balance.rule: Outstanding = original debt − approved payments that were not reversed. Pending, rejected and reversed money never counts as recovered.

money.reversalKept: A reversal is a compensating event. The original receipt and its approval stay on record.
money.legacyChanges: Changes made in the old screens

promises.title: Promises to pay
promises.subtitle: Explicitly agreed amounts and due dates. A promise is fulfilled only by approved payments allocated to it.
promises.emptyHint: No promise in your scope matches this state and these filters.
promises.footNote: States come from the server using Riyadh dates: overdue means the due date is before today in Riyadh and the promise is not fully covered.
promises.stateNote: A "promise discussed" call outcome never creates a promise, and a promise never creates a payment.
promises.baselineHint: recorded before Phase 1. Whether it was fulfilled before then is unknown, not unfulfilled; old payments were not allocated to it.
promises.cancelHint: Any active allocations are voided and kept in the history.
promises.noAllocatablePayments: This case has no approved payment with unallocated money.
promises.allocAmountHint: Leave empty to allocate the most both the payment and the promise allow.
promises.deallocateHint: The allocation is voided, not deleted, and the promise state is recalculated. Amount:
promises.amountHint: More than zero, at most 2 decimals, and not above the outstanding balance.
promises.amountFormat: Use digits with at most 2 decimals, e.g. 1500.50
promises.amountPositive: The amount must be more than zero.
promises.dueHint: Today or later (Riyadh date, today is {{today}}).
promises.dueInPast: The due date cannot be before today ({{today}}, Riyadh).
promises.createNote: Record only an amount and date the debtor explicitly agreed to.

casePromises.emptyHint: Record a promise only when the debtor agrees to an amount and a date.
casePromises.locked: The case is locked, so new promises cannot be recorded.
casePromises.noPayments: No payments recorded on this case.

desk.title: Payment approvals
desk.subtitle: Approve or reject submitted payments; reverse an approved one with a compensating record.
desk.commentHint: For example the bank slip or transfer reference you checked. It is kept with your name.
desk.approveNote: The server checks the exact outstanding balance before approving. Approval also fills the case's open promises, oldest due first.
desk.reverseExplain: A reversal is a compensating event: the receipt and its approval stay on record, the amount stops counting as recovered, and its promise allocations are voided (a fulfilled promise can reopen).
desk.emptyHint: No payment in your scope matches this status and these filters.
desk.footNote: Pending and rejected amounts never count as recovered. Payments are submitted from the case screen; this desk only decides them.
